Results.ReviewText:
The unit (Pro 575) worked well to start and for the first year, it was fairly reliable... But after about 6-months worth of cooks averaging 2 to 8 times a month, the temperature could not be trusted and was wildly inaccurate. Then the igniter became temperamental only starting when it felt like starting... All this while being diligent about cleaning the unit after 1 to 2 smokes... 
Now it doesn't even ignight any longer. No coercing it to light any longer even after trying to fix it so my disappointment is thorough and complete.

It should be noted to all you potential buyers that if there is a known and well written fix documented on the web site about this type of issue, you might want to stay away unless you like tinkering with this kind of problem. As I am not one of them, hense the 1 star rating. 

To Traegar: If these are just throw away grills, then please, price them accordingly. You could probably make some money by having a program to come and pick up these boat anchors while recycling the parts. As is though, this hunk of junk albatross is going to be hard to get rid of...I double dog dare you to call me and pick it up.

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Bronze - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText:
This traeger is absolutely a hunk of garbage. 2 days after purchase the auger broke. Treager unwilling to help, I returned it to Home Depot and got a new one. It has been a constant battle with this grill. It is horrible at maintaining ambient temperatures (even being covered with Treagers overpriced temperature retaining padded cover). The pellet bowl will constantly overfill and cause the traeger to shut off showing "LEF". If it doesn't shut off the massive amount of pellets will smolder and cause a nasty yellow smoke show ruining whatever food is inside, followed by a flash over causing the grill to be filled with giant flames and temperatures well over 500 degrees (yes, I only use Traeger brand pellets and yes I clean out the pellet bowl constantly, which in itself is a pain in the butt). This grill has ruined many special events for me and has destroyed a massive amount of fine meats that I have put a lot of effort and hard work into. I am deeply unsatisfied with this Traeger. Long ago I was passed down a Traeger grill that was my fathers for many years and it was a great product that continued to work for me for many years as well. These new products are not only overpriced, but are cheaply made and extremely disappointing. DO NOT buy this product or support this brand. 
I know this sounds like one of those typical annoying product rants that you read and dismiss but you will be better off passing on this product and going with a different brand. I am very ashamed with this Traeger and this brands overall cheaply made, overpriced products. Truly saddened that I will cannot recommend or stand behind this brand any longer.
Results.Title: Problems.

We brined the turkey for almost 24 hours and then as the instructions on the packet said patted it dry, rubbed it down with a little oil and put the Traeger rub on it. We put it in a disposable aluminum pan and into the Traeger. The only other things we did was insert the temp problem and after a period of smoking, turned up the temp. This was on a 32 and below temperature day and still the bird was cooked to perfection. It has wonderful flavor and aroma. It beat out the oven roasted turkey by a mile. My wife who has taken great pride in doing the Martha Stewart turkey recipe in the oven next year even commented that the Traeger Turkey was no much less effort to prepare and was the winner on flavor. Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 575 Pellet Grill - Black
Results.ReviewText:
This grill was gifted for our wedding.. I was very excited to begin using it. The app is very  intuitive and easy to use, it was easy to assemble.  

What I've noticed, my first few cooks I've had significant trouble getting the meat up to to temp in the specified time. For example, 3,2,1 Ribs, after 6 hours were only at 140F (cooking at 220) Condering Traegers recipe tells you to hit 190 or 200F,  I resorted to finishing on the bbq so my guest could eat at a decent time. Embarrassing. 

  At first I thought it was the meat probe, so I checked with another probe and calibrated it, it was fine.   I read everything on the Traeger troubleshooting, used quality pellets, checked for air flow and gaps or anything blocking the heat etc.

What  I found is the cooking surface was significantly lower in temperature then what the digital controller was reading.  170F when the grill said 220. No wonder my food did not cook.

I got ahold of multiple people on the support line, which is handy as its basically text messaging, however there only check for the thermocouple is that is can read the ambient temperature fine and they send you an article about how third party thermometers shouldn't be used because "They cannot detect variance and hot and cold spots".   Well the cold spot is where the meat is cooked, so thats a problem lol.

 That's nonsense. The thermocouple on the grill is placed directly above the flame and fan so the heat  reading is off.   They told me its fine and basically to do better.   It was even suggested that the grill was sitting in the sun which compromised the accuracy lol, I live in southern Canada and its nearly winter. 

 If you research even a little bit online  you can see this is an ongoing issue with the grill Traeger obviously does not take seriously.  Not one that can't be overcome, but do not expect Traeger to take accountability. 

 I will be using my own oven thermometer  to monitor temperature moving forward and will update this review with my findings. I'm excited to use this grill again but cooking my own way, because even at low temperature the food has been great, so when cooked correctly I think it will be even better. 

If I had paid for this grill I would of returned it and purchased something less expensive that I knew I'd have to monitor myself.  At the very least, the meat probe is bang on, maybe I had too high of expectations for the digital controller.
Results.Title: Temperature Issues. Purchaser beware

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 575 Pellet Grill - Black
Results.ReviewText: Wife and I bought this a few months ago at Home Depot so thought I better write a review. So far, we are very happy with our Traeger, very easy to use and food tastes great. I love the Wi-fi and the app, very handy to monitor what's going on while away from the grille. When I first saw the box, I was sad knowing there was probably a ton of Styrofoam to deal with getting rid of. I was so surprised to see that there was not ONE piece of Styrofoam in the box. This is about the smartest packing of any product I have every purchased!! The assembly was very straight forward and easy, the instructions are very easy to follow. My only few negatives I have so far is 1), I wish they would include the casters on the solid legs to make it easier to move around, the handle is awkward to move it since it is so short or make the handle deeper. 2) the lid on ours doesn't quite fit the contour of the barrel letting smoke escape around the bottom portion of the lid. I've checked several other floor models at the stores and all of them seal tight all the way around the lid. It looks like the lid wasn't formed completely to match the barrel section of the grill. Not a huge deal but for the money the lid should fit perfectly. (I tried to add a photo of the lid, but the link didn't work) Also, I think the folding shelf and pellet monitor should be included with the Pro series, for this much money it would make it a perfect model. I have purchased and installed both items and they are worth the extra money. One thing I have found is that all the Traeger accessories are on the expensive side, I know they are made very well but really priced high. Overall if you are looking for a pellet grill, I would recommend a Traeger hands down!!

Results.ReviewText: I have had a tracer for years and it does a great job.  One thing to remember is it won’t combine charcoal flavor with wood like a true smoker does.  If you want that flavor go with a gravity smoker.  But, for easy smokin it does the trick! 2007 Kansas state championship, and 2008 first place American Royal BBQ pork champion.  Also, 3 years in a row Kingsford classic whole hog champ!
Results.Title: Great smoker

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 575 Pellet Grill - Bronze - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: Very fast delivery. Have had it roughly 2 weeks and have been smoking pretty much every day. This Pro575 is awesome. Best purchase ever for sure
Results.Title: Pro575 is awesome

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 575 Pellet Grill - Black
Results.ReviewText: I’m on my Traeger 575 pro almost 3 years ago after getting tired gas grills that just cook my food and added no flavor. I was an average grill guy until my Traeger. Then one day my Traeger died. It would not come on at all even though the light came on on the back of it. I had no idea I had a three-year warranty until Traeger told me when I called them. It’s a REAL warranty- not some pay a percentage sort of thing. My control panel had died and it was a $300 part that I paid absolutely nothing for including the shipping of the part to me. Yes, I will continue to buy their pellets and other goods because I appreciate a company that keeps its promises- even when the customer didn’t even know they’d made that promise.
Results.Title: The Grills are Great; Service is even better!

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 575 Pellet Grill - Bronze - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: Unit does a good job smoking the meat, but the temp on the probe is always high.  I've calibrated it numerous times with no help.  Also, if you have a mesh WiFi system, it can be hard to do the initial setup as the grill only operates on 2.4GHz, and on most phones there is no way to force it to 2.4 from 5GHz.
Results.Title: Good Smoker, Technology is So-so

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 575 Pellet Grill - Black
Results.ReviewText: bought this smoker new sealed in the box and used it less than a dozen times and the $300 controller has gone bad. Traeger will not honor the warranty because i bought it from a friend instead of a vendor. i regret this purchase. great product when it works but its too exspensive to repair for me to use anytime soon.
Results.Title: traeger will not honor your warranty

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Black
Results.ReviewText: The grill is unbelievable! The delivery process was the worst I’ve ever encountered. I’ll buy from Amazon next time. Your customer service rep needs training. Tell me “no worries” after everything I said just made it worse.

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Black - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: I have to say that I didn't expect the grill the have to be updates, program wise when I got it from the factory. The firm wear was out of date and it took 3 days of being plugged in and on before it updated.  The meat temp probe was way off the so was the thermo couple for the heat. Once those item were corrected it seems to be working well. I have cooked several meals on it and the different tastes from the pellets is pretty awesome.
Results.Title: Great meals

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Black

ClientResponses.Response:
Hey there. Thank you for reviewing our Pro 780. We truly appreciate the feedback. Welcome to the Traegerhood.
The handle should not get so hot while cooking, that it burns your bare hand. These models do not have wheels on all 4 sides for better stability, and to maintain levelness while cooking. 
As for the meat probe, there is a way to calibrate them straight from the controller. Please go to Menu> Settings> Probe> Probe calibration. It will direct you to make an ice water bath for the probe to calibrate it, and then if it still does not read properly after that, you can offset it by 1F increments in the controller to manually make it read proper temps to ensure it is working properly for you. 
If you have any other questions and/or concerns, please do not hesitate to give us a call to speak with one of our live agents, available 7 days a week from 6am-10pm MST. (including holidays) We're always happy to help.

Results.ReviewText: Nice grill.  Only used once so far.  Grill seems to be well built.  Handle gets too hot to handle with bare hand at 450 degrees.   Would also be better if it had swivel wheels on all 4 legs instead of just 2.  Probe was not very accurate either.  It reads about 20 degrees high.  I hope there is a way to calibrate it.  Cooked burgers and they were juicier and less shrinkage and no burn marks like gas grill flare ups caused.  Had to use handheld thermometer to get them done.
Results.Title: Good but could use some improvements.

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Bronze - In Store Only

Photos.Caption: Here are some of the cooks we’ve done. The pork loin has an amazing smoke ring for a pellet grill

Results.ReviewText: So I wrestled back and forth about getting this grill or the ironwood. At first I thought I made the wrong choice. But this grill is awesome! We cook everything on this thing, I would suggest getting a grill gasket for the lid. That made a big difference in the use of pellets. If you’re on the fence regarding the ironwood or this one because of the extra settings, you still have the capability to super smoke if you do it under 200 degrees. It does add about an hour or so to your cook but it’s with it for the taste! Overall I love the grill, I do wish the upper rack was a little wider and that the lower rack had another setting to raise it up slightly. But it’s a great grill! You’ll love it
Results.Title: Worth It!!

Results.ReviewText: There is no Super smoker setting on this model, so to smoke you need to be at 225*.  Some recipes ask for Super Smoke.  This will cause longer cook time, but still great eating.
Results.Title: Nice slow cook..

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Bronze - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: ---THIS IS NOT A SMOKER---It is an expensive worthless GRILL--->Bought this for my Father it was his last Christmas before he passed. I expected it to be a nice gift instead he stopped using it and went back to his old briquet smoker. Now it's mine. Why did he not like it you ask? Because it doesn't hardly make smoke. Sure the fist 5 minutes look like a chimney but then NOTHING!!! Unlike Traeger's cheaper models the 780 as no "smoke setting" and good luck keeping it at a lower temperature, the fan just keeps going as the grill consistently reaches temperatures 150 degrees above what has been set to especially when trying to cook at lower temps (180-225) -I spent $1,000 on a joke
Results.Title: Do Not buy this one

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 575 Pellet Grill - Black
Results.ReviewText: I purchased my 575 about 2 months ago.  I was excited to enjoy the control and ease of use it would give me.  So far it’s been a nightmare hundreds of dollars of ruined food.  I followed the recipes on the app and they take hours longer then it should.  The grill is super hot on the vent end and cool on the other.  I had the grill full and the butter sauce on one side  was burnt and the other side cold and solid.  A turkey we made was burnt on the bottom and raw on top.  The grill is maintained and clean.  There is no answer from Traeger on what the issue could be.  They said check and see if it’s level.  The fun and excitement are gone and I’m back to using my Broil King.  In the end all I do with it is roast at 400 cause I can’t cook any other way.  I don’t recommend Traeger at all.  Total let down
Results.Title: So disappointed
